title: Fine-Grained Detoxification via Instance-Level Prefixes for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes an evaluation component that tests how Large Language Models respond to prompts concerning religious groups (e.g., Muslims) and moral judgments (e.g., the morality of sexual orientation). Specifically, Table 13 and Table 14 show experiments using the FFT dataset to ensure the model produces non-toxic and neutral responses to sensitive religious and moral questions.
